title: Hanasato Minori — To Sparkle More〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff...! Huff...!
I'm sorry for being late!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
M-Morning, Haruka!
Huh? Where's the teacher...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Not here yet.
So, you just barely made it in time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, you're hardly ever late.
Are you not feeling well by chance?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I'm fine!
I honestly just overslept today...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I basically expended all of my energy at Idol Lovers, so I can't really recall what happened after I took my bath last night...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
You did put in a huge effort yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, take your seats. Class is about to start.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, the teacher's here...
Be careful to not fall asleep during class, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I won't! Thanks for the concern, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The training we did leading up to it was really hard, but I was able to perform as well as I did because of it...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I'm really glad I put in the effort.
And everyone in the audience was having so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(It still feels like I'm in a dream...!
I mean, I got to stand on that stage...!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Let's see... Who can solve this problem for me...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hanasato, you seem to be enjoying yourself.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: What is the value of x here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?!
I wasn't listening at all just now...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(N-No, don't worry!
I always make sure to look up this stuff beforehand. For this problem...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait, I didn't last night because I collapsed out of exhaustion!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
I see.
Please be sure to pay attention.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Now, I'll be collecting the homework I assigned last week.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wait a second... I vaguely remember us being asked to translate stuff into regular Japanese for Classics...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, so... I planned on doing it last night...! But... Umm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I forgot to do my homework and bring my gym uniform... Talk about a horrendous morning...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Hey.
You had a pretty rough morning...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
You even fell face-first into the sand pit.
Are you still feeling pretty tired from that show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But every time I think about our performance at Idol Lovers, I end up daydreaming...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get how you feel.
Not only was yesterday's show amazing, but we ended up putting on some incredible performances.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we do need to stay focused.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We still have to go to school, and another job coming up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(We have to keep working.
Just because something good happened to us, we can't rest on our laurels.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(So!
I need to be able to switch gears more smoothly!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna review what we covered in class during lunch!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll help.
That should benefit both of us.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Oh, we'll join you guys!
We wanna help you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna get my head back on straight and do my best during afternoon classes!
